tools.name: carat_to_mm
tools.description: Diameter in millimetres for a given carat weight. Round brilliant cut. Density-corrected per stone - a diamond chart is wrong for moissanite by ~9%.

tools.name: mm_to_carat
tools.description: Carat weight for a given diameter in millimetres. Round brilliant cut.

tools.name: grading_scale
tools.description: GIA colour (D-K) or clarity (FL-SI) scale as used for moissanite, or published optical constants for moissanite / diamond / cubic zirconia.

tools.name: ring_size_convert
tools.description: Convert a ring size between US, UK, EU (ISO 8653) and inner diameter in mm. A US 6 is a UK M, not a UK 6.

tools.name: necklace_length
tools.description: Where a necklace of a given length sits, with the trade name (choker, princess, matinee...).

tools.name: stud_appearance
tools.description: How a round stud of a given stone diameter reads on the ear.
